description.value: Northwinds Hotel Revelstoke is a modern two-storey mountain hotel operated by Basecamp Resorts, located minutes from downtown Revelstoke and the surrounding trail network. Part of a growing collection of Canadian mountain retreats, it offers rooms ranging from standard king rooms to multi-bed apartments sleeping up to eight guests, with locally sourced bath products and comfortable linens. Its location makes it a practical launching point for cyclists exploring the trails, shops, and scenery of one of BC's most celebrated mountain towns.
